vars.question: How do I export a note as PDF?
vars.source: stage-02 backlog: traces t0038, t0039 (failed)
vars.reference: Open the note, select More or the three-dot menu, choose Export, select PDF, then select Export or Create PDF and save the file.

vars.question: How do I create a note and rename it?
vars.source: stage-02 traces: resolved sample (a control case)
vars.reference: Open Quillnote, select New Note, type a title and your text. Quillnote saves changes as you type. To rename, edit the title.

vars.question: How do I add a tag?
vars.source: stage-02 backlog: traces t0007, t0012 (failed)
vars.reference: Use folders to group notes and tags to label notes across folders. To add a tag, open the note, select Tags and type a tag name.

vars.question: How do I search my notes by title?
vars.source: stage-02 traces: resolved sample (a control case)
vars.reference: Tap the Search field at the top of the notes list and type a word. Narrow results with the title:, tag: or date: filters.

vars.question: My notes are not syncing. How do I fix sync?
vars.source: stage-02 backlog: traces t0051, t0064 (failed), reworded
vars.reference: Check your connection, pull to refresh or tap Sync, confirm the account in Settings > Account, and look for errors in Settings > Sync.

vars.question: Where is dark mode?
vars.source: stage-02 backlog: traces t0077, t0161 (failed)
vars.reference: Open Settings, select Appearance or Themes, and choose Light, Dark or System. In Themes you can browse color presets, preview one and save it.

vars.question: How do I undo a deleted note?
vars.source: stage-02 backlog: traces t0067, t0122 (failed)
vars.reference: Open Trash in the sidebar, find the note, open it and select Restore. Notes stay in Trash for 30 days before permanent removal.

vars.question: Can I keep writing notes without internet?
vars.source: stage-02 traces: resolved sample (a control case)
vars.reference: Quillnote works offline: keep reading and editing notes without internet. Changes stay on your device and sync when you are online again.

vars.question: What does the Pro plan include?
vars.source: stage-07 feedback: thumbs down, answer listed the wrong plans
vars.reference: Quillnote has three plans: Free, Plus and Pro. Compare them in Settings > Plans and Pricing. Pro adds shared notebooks, version history and priority support.

vars.question: Can I share a notebook with my team?
vars.source: stage-02 backlog: traces t0020, t0042 (failed)
vars.reference: Open the notebook, click Share, enter teammates' email addresses, choose Can view, Can edit or Can manage, then click Send invite.

vars.question: What can a Viewer do on a team?
vars.source: stage-07 feedback: edit, the answer said Viewers can edit
vars.reference: Team roles are Owner, Admin, Editor and Viewer. Viewers can open and read shared notes but cannot edit content. Change roles in Settings > Members.

vars.question: How do I make a template my team can reuse?
vars.source: stage-02 traces: resolved sample (a control case)
vars.reference: Go to Templates, select Team Templates, click New Template, add the sections and Save, then share the template with your team.

vars.question: Can I print a note?
vars.source: stage-07 feedback: thumbs down, no print steps
vars.reference: Open the note, select More or the three-dot menu, choose Export, select PDF, then select Export or Create PDF and save the file.
